component.name: Robrix
component.summary: Powerful Matrix chat with dockable tabs for many rooms at once

description.p: Robrix is a powerful, sleek Matrix chat client written from scratch in Rust. It brings some cool new features to the world of Matrix, like our signature "dockable tabs" layout that lets you view and interact with multiple rooms or threads simultaneously. This works just like your favorite multi-tab IDE or web browser, letting you keep tabs on as many conversations as you want.

Robrix stays sleek and smooth even under heavy usage. We designed it to be fast and light (but also feature-rich), thanks to the Makepad UI toolkit and the Robius app dev framework, which we've also written from scratch It's fully native on every platform: no Electron, no underlying web engine, no JavaScript, and no cruft. Scrolling through many rooms at once with millions of messages each is no problem. Native sliding sync logs you in quickly, and your rooms list fully syncs without a long wait. We also went to great lengths to ensure that Robrix's room timeline view is consistent and predictable; it won't unexpectedly jump around while loading messages, images, or other room content. We've always found this to be annoying in other chat apps.
Robrix runs on all other major platforms too: Android, iOS, macOS, and Windows, where you can get the same flexible UI and powerful featureset, even on mobile.

Matrix is an open protocol for secure, decentralized chat and other communication, built with privacy at its core. Instead of trusting one company with all of your messages, you create an account on a homeserver of your choice, run by a community, an employer, a government, or even yourself, and talk to anyone on any other homeserver across the world. It's basically like email, but fully encrypted and real-time. No ads, no analytics, no data brokers.
Robrix supports nearly all the main Matrix client features you'd expect:

ul.li: End-to-end encryption (E2EE) + verification for secure chat across public, private, and DM rooms
Fast login and room updates via native sliding sync
Room timelines with rich text, images, files, location sharing, and link previews
Standard rich text, plus extras like formatted tables and details/summary blocks
Full support for inline replies, threads/threaded replies, and reactions
Robust Spaces support: a dedicated multi-room dock view for each space! (and you can explore and join rooms and sub-spaces, as usual)
Upload, download, and share files and media (images/videos)
Edit any message you sent without losing your current draft
Instantly mention (and filter through) users and rooms
Join or leave rooms by link, alias, or room ID
Send and respond to invites, including full support for knocking on rooms
Login via SSO or username and password
Offline mode with a persistent local event cache

description.p: Robrix is free and open source. Contributions, bug reports, and feature requests are more than welcome.
